title: design-taste
description: A person's design taste rules, read by the design-onboard skill and copied into each repo's PRODUCT.md and AGENTS.md. Lives at ~/.config/process-pack/design-taste.yaml and is never committed. Every rule follows the taste-rules anatomy: default stance, applicability gate, named exceptions, escape hatch. Holds no brand values and no default reference products.

id.description: Short stable identifier, lowercase words joined by hyphens.

default_stance.description: What happens with no further judgment applied. Plain and enforceable.

applicability_gate.description: The checkable condition under which the default applies.

named_exceptions.description: Cases, stated in advance, where the default does not hold. May be empty.

escape_hatch.description: How the person overrides the rule anyway: express, in-session permission.

version.description: Schema version this file was written against, e.g. "1.0".

looks_to_avoid.description: Visual looks that read as generic or dated, each as a rule.

craft_floor.description: The minimum finish every screen reaches: type levels, interaction states, data states.

color_discipline.description: Where color comes from and what it is allowed to mean.

accessibility_floor.description: The accessibility level every theme meets.

points_at.description: Names of skills that own the copy method in full. Onboarding points at them rather than copying them.

dimensions.description: The dimensions a critique scores, in order.

each_point_needs_fix.description: When true, every critique point must carry a concrete fix.

notes.description: Short guidance per dimension or for the method as a whole.
